summary: Mountain Rescue Aspen member John Galvin, 57, killed with a partner in an avalanche in Maroon Bowl just outside the Aspen Highlands Ski Area boundary; partner survived; body recovered April 10 by an 11-member MRA team with spotters atop Aspen Highlands and a Colorado Army National Guard Blackhawk insertion
location: Maroon Bowl, outside Aspen Highlands Ski Area boundary
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen + Colorado Army National Guard High Altitude Aviation Training Site
notes: Recovery delayed by adverse snow conditions April 8-9; mission completed April 10 at 09:12 under CAIC snow-safety guidance | Run 173: CAIC classic 2017-18 table (opened this run) says 2 sidecountry riders caught, 1 killed — victim count corrected 1 to 2.
